Title: How to know if RedissonMap is created at redis end 
Description: Is there a way to know if a map with given name is created at redis end. As per understanding, org.redisson.api.RedissonClient.getMap(java.lang.String name) always gives new RedissonMap and only creates interacts with redis when one does any map operations like get/put. 
Which means Using org.redisson.api.RedissonClient.getMap(java.lang.String name) will not send any request to redis ?
So how can i know that if a map with given name already exists at redis end using any of the redisson apis?
